premises.text: Talk media like podcasts and radio are long and not interactive, failing to cater to mobile-first content creators.
premises.evidence_span: All these talk media have the same problem. They're long. They're not interactive.

premises.text: Pundit allows users to create bite-sized talk shows about their favorite topics.
premises.evidence_span: Pundit is a platform that empowers you to unleash your inner Oprah.

premises.text: Users can engage in conversations through the Pundit app.
Pundit enhances audio content with features like background noise reduction and voice filters.
premises.evidence_span: Pundit will automatically reduce the background noise and engineer your voice to make you sound your best.

premises.text: Pundit offers a feature for sending private voice messages that disappear in 24 hours.
premises.evidence_span: introducing the Pundit voice box, a feature where you can send private voice messages that disappear in 24 hours.

premises.text: Pundit aims to make voice content lightweight, interactive, and fun.
premises.evidence_span: we aim to do today a talk, the radio, the podcast, just like what Snapchat has been doing to photos, making talk more lightweight, interactive, and fun.

premises.text: Pundit has onboarded thousands of creators and maintains a high engagement rate.
premises.evidence_span: we have onboarded thousands of YouTubers and similar creators to the platform. And the results are amazing. We've maintained an engagement rate of about 35% daily active over monthly active users.

premises.text: Pundit allows creators to share their content on other social platforms and embed it on websites.
premises.evidence_span: creators can share their Pundit talks on other social platforms and natively embed them on any website.

premises.text: Pundit has partnered with major brands like the Walt Disney Company for content creation.
premises.evidence_span: this opened a new world of possibilities for brands and top-notch creators to create and distribute awesome audio content. Yes, even brands like the Walt Disney Company.

premises.text: Pundit will expand to Android and launch in Asian and Middle Eastern markets.
premises.evidence_span: Pundit will also be releasing our Android version and launching in Asian and Middle Eastern markets.

value.text: Pundit makes voice content creation fun, interactive, and accessible.
value.evidence_span: So yeah, speaking publicly is fun, but sometimes you just want to have that private exchange.
